parsed.summary: Tracing every rail, net label and passive against the specification, the schematic is internally consistent and matches the intended design (power mux IN1=+12V/IN2=+5V with PR1/OV/CP/ST at GND, ILIM=51.1k, SS=10nF; AP63203 buck with FB tied to the 3V3 output and 3.9uH inductor; TPS1H200 heater switch with VS=+12V, IN/DIAG_EN from the GPIO1/NET0017 control net, CL/GND/EP to GND and FAULT broken out only to a test point; three MAX31855 channels sharing SCK/SO with independent CS nets that reappear on the MCU; USB-C 5.1k CC pulldowns; WS2812 and fan-tach TVS/pull-up networks). The features that superficially look wrong (the 12V rail diode drawn as a plain Device:D rather than D_TVS, the heater-switch FAULT pin not returned to the MCU, the LED-on-control-net arrangement) are exactly the documented 'known limitations' of the reference design, not deviations, and the differing reference designators are just a renumbering of the same netlist. No anomaly is supported by the drawing.
